response_deadline_contract.snapshot_basis: Response fields are the historical response state at command.attempt and can describe the preceding command. Raw historical sent/ack/confirmed timestamps remain unchanged.
response_deadline_contract.electrical-response: Only when pending vehicle_response has an ACK at or after sentAt: ackAt + 45000 ms.
response_deadline_contract.command-ack: When a command is pending without a qualifying ACK: sentAt + 20000 ms.
response_deadline_contract.inactive: For confirmed/idle or any non-pending state, derived deadline is empty, never zero. Old raw response timestamps do not imply an active deadline.
response_deadline_contract.unknown: Missing required timestamp leaves the derived deadline empty; no clock is invented.
